# OpenAI announcements / model surface — captured 2026-08-07

## GPT-5.6 family — GA July 9, 2026 [REPORTED 2026-08-07]
Model IDs: `gpt-5.6-sol` (frontier reasoning / long-horizon agentic), `gpt-5.6-terra` (balanced),
`gpt-5.6-luna` (fast/low-cost). Bare alias `gpt-5.6` routes to Sol.
1.05M-token context, 128K max output, text+image in, streaming, structured outputs, function calling,
file search, web search, prompt caching. Reasoning effort ladder: none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max.
Available via the Responses API and OpenAI client SDKs — self-serve, no waitlist.
Pricing per 1M tokens: Sol $5/$30, Terra $2.50/$15, Luna $1/$6 (Luna -80% / Terra -20% on Jul 30).
Official: https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-6/ , https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models
This closes the 2026-07-08 forward-watch on the Sol/Terra/Luna family.

## Sign in with ChatGPT — live beta Aug 2, 2026 [REPORTED]
OpenAI's first cross-platform identity system. Named launch partners: Airtable, GitLab, HubSpot,
Notion, Supabase, Vercel. Also on OpenAI Academy and Codex Sites. Relying party receives name, email
address, profile picture. Available globally to authenticated ChatGPT users INCLUDING Enterprise
org members, subject to org admin settings.
https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001410-sign-in-with-chatgpt

## Content provenance [REPORTED]
C2PA Content Credentials + Google SynthID watermarking across images (and, since July 2026, audio)
generated via ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API. API access for verification now shipped in the
SDKs as "content provenance checks"; public verification tool in preview.
https://openai.com/index/advancing-content-provenance/

## Still watching
- `gpt-realtime-2.1` / `-mini`: forum-only since ~Jul 6; still absent from SDK/docs. Continue watch.

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Community forum itself contributed nothing above the bar this scan; the GPT-5.6
family is now reported on the strength of official docs/SDK/Codex sources.
